subject: EdgeBridge resale partner premium discount — approval request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: procurement@edgebridge.com
Date: 2027-07-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + packaging question before demo

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for the time on the call today. Re: the marketplace/resale flow you outlined, a couple quick items before we move to a formal quote:

- You mentioned you want to resell Redwood-powered inference as part of your managed analytics package and incentive the first-year uptake with a margin-friendly price.
- For that use-case we typically offer a resale partner rate tied to a committed ARR floor and co-selling credits.

I'm preparing a short internal memo and authorization request for an introductory partner discount that would be available if EdgeBridge signs a 24-month commitment of $420k ARR or higher. Can you confirm approximate expected first-year consumption (tokens/month or seats) so I can size the proposal accurately?

Also please confirm if you need us to include a reseller addendum in the SOW or if you'll handle downstream invoicing.

If you prefer, I can send a formal pricing worksheet and a proposed partner memo for signoff by EOD.

Thanks,
Jonas
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: EdgeBridge resale partner premium discount — request for VP/CFO approval

Marissa / Markus —

Forwarding the outbound thread with EdgeBridge. Short summary and ask below.

Summary: EdgeBridge (Sasha) is evaluating Redwood as a resale partner. They want an initial partner discount to seed customer adoption in the first 12 months plus a co-sell credit. We have a 24-month commitment ask. The commercial they want would be: 30% off list for year one on hosted inference usage (tokens) with a guaranteed $420k ARR commitment across 24 months (blended). Year two reverts to standard partner tier pricing (15% discount) unless consumption materially exceeds the forecast.

Business justification:
- Strategic channel entry: EdgeBridge has an existing managed analytics customer base of ~150 enterprise customers across finance and retail.
- Upside: If successful, they will incorporate Redwood as a platform offering; estimated incremental ARR pipeline of $1.2M over 36 months (conservative).
- Retention: Resale model accelerates adoption in regulated verticals where EdgeBridge has existing contracts.

Request: I need VP/CFO level signoff to approve a one-time introductory reseller discount (30% first-year) and the reseller addendum. This requires an exception to our standard channel guardrails (discount >25% and multi-year blended floor).

Attachments included: pricing worksheet (edgebridge_pricing_proposal.xlsx), draft memo for exec signoff (resale_partner_memo.pdf), SOW draft (edgebridge_sow_v2.docx).

Proposed approval language (for your convenience):

- Approve 30% introductory partner discount for EdgeBridge tied to execution of a 24-month contract with a minimum $420k ARR commitment (total contracted $840k).
- Approve co-sell credit of up to 8% of net new ACV for first 12 months.
- Finance to confirm revenue recognition and refund/cancellation protection (prorated recapture clause for terminations within first 12 months).

Can you review and let me know if we should escalate to CFO? I am happy to take this to you both for signature.

Thanks — Jonas

Attachments: edgebridge_pricing_proposal.xlsx; resale_partner_memo.pdf; edgebridge_sow_v2.docx
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-07-08T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeBridge resale partner premium discount — request for VP/CFO approval

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attach. I skimmed the numbers. A few clarifying items before I take to Marissa / CFO:

1) ARR floor math: the $420k ARR on a 24-month term equals $840k committed total. Please confirm if the $420k is first-year expected ARR or a blended annualized commitment.
2) Refund/recapture: what's the proposed recapture schedule? We need a 12–24 month catchback clause for refunds if they churn below 60% of forecast.
3) Territory/conflict: any overlapping accounts where EdgeBridge already resells competing inference products? We should confirm a carveout list.
4) Payment terms: do they require Net-90 or extended terms? Extended payment terms materially change the finance risk here.

If those are answered we can propose a conditional approval: allow the 30% introductory discount with a step-down to 20% if year-one consumption < 60% of forecast, and require CFO sign-off on the recapture language.

Markus
Head of Commercial Operations

(quoted original memo below)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-08T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeBridge resale partner premium discount — request for VP/CFO approval

Jonas / Markus —

I reviewed the memo and the projected economic uplift. I support a controlled exception here given the strategic channel benefit, but we need tighter guardrails before CFO will sign. My directions: 

1) Make the 30% introductory discount conditional on EdgeBridge executing the reseller addendum and a $420k ARR contractual minimum (specifically call out first-year minimum consumption buckets).
2) Add a prorated recapture clause: if actual year-one usage is <60% of the forecasted tokens, Redwood reserves the right to invoice the difference at a 20% catch-up rate.
3) Payment terms limited to Net-45; no Net-90 without Finance escalation.
4) Require a carveout schedule listing ten priority customers EdgeBridge may not reprice or resell under this program for the first 12 months.

Marcus (CC'd) — can you confirm revenue recognition / billing mechanics for this structure and confirm whether Finance needs additional collateral? If everything checks out, I will sign the exception memo and route to CFO for final fiscal sign-off.

Marissa
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Subject: EdgeBridge pricing exception — conditional approval and next steps

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. We are willing to approve a one-time introductory partner program offer for EdgeBridge under the following conditions: 

1) Contract: 24-month Master Services Agreement including Redwood reseller addendum signed by both parties and countersigned by EdgeBridge legal.
2) Commitment: Minimum contracted ARR of $420,000 (annualized) as part of the 24-month term.
3) Pricing: 30% off list on hosted inference usage for year one, stepping to 15% in year two.
4) Guardrails: If actual year-one consumption is below 60% of forecast, Redwood reserves the right to invoice a catch-up at a 20% rate (prorated).
5) Payment terms: Net-45. Extended payment terms will require separate Finance approval.
6) Carveout: EdgeBridge to provide a list of ten priority accounts that are excluded from any promotional pricing for 12 months.

Next steps: Jonas will upload the finalized SOW and the reseller addendum to the HubSpot deal and share for signature. Marcus (Finance) will validate billing and revenue mechanics and then I will route the signed exception memo to our CFO for final fiscal confirmation.

Jonas — please push the DocuSign and confirm expected sign date so we can lock the eligibility window for the introductory price. Sasha — appreciate if you can confirm the carveout list by EOD Monday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
